g.text: Urban Taxi Mobility Analytics - End-to-End Activity Workflow
Stream Raw T-Drive GPS Trajectory Logs
Project GPS Fixes into 500m Equirectangular Grid Cells
Compute Pairwise Haversine Distances in Radians
Mine Multi-Hop Gapped Subsequences via PrefixSpan (len<=4)
Pair-level TP, FP, FN, P, R, F1
Compute Route Median Durations & Travel-Time Variances
Export Summary Tables, Benchmark Results & Manifests
Render Interactive Folium Spatial Maps & Streamlit Dashboard
